content:
Apple today released an interesting advertisement promoting the all-new Mac mini equipped with the M6 chip. The company also released a short behind-the-scenes making-of video showcasing the effort that went into producing the ad. Check it out below.

"We had to hand-sculpt and create everything"

Apple's @helloapple Instagram account today published a brief Instagram Reels video showing how the advertisement for the all-new Mac mini with the M6 chip was created.

In the video (via MacMagazine), animators Justin Rasch and Scott DaRos, along with art director Josh Mahan, show off the sketches, props, sculptures, techniques, and materials used during the production process, as well as stop-motion time-lapses and behind-the-scenes clips revealing how some of the animation in the ad came together.

Although this ad is not quite as wild as the MacBook Neo TikTok campaign—which has been absolutely brilliant since Apple launched this entry-level laptop—it is already quite entertaining on its own, and it becomes even better once you know how much physical work went into making it.
